mailer.title: Mailer rate vs portal rate
mailer.text: The printed mailer shows the family medical premium at $486.19/pay; the enrollment portal shows $473.55. The portal figure is the one that will be deducted — the mailer was printed before the October rate correction.

mailer.title: HSA seed money
mailer.text: Northstar Systems seeds the HSA with $500 in January and another $250 in July if a biometric screening is on file by May 31.

change.title: HSA contribution
change.note: Raise toward the family maximum in two steps so the January budget is not squeezed.

change.title: Dental plan
change.note: The child’s orthodontia consult is not expected until 2027; the DHMO covers the consult at a copay instead of coinsurance.

keep.why: The family deductible was met in March, so switching plans mid-stream would restart it; the premium gap to the leaner plan is $13.88/pay, less than one urgent-care visit.
At $6.84/pay it pays for itself with one pair of glasses; Maya’s prescription changed in August.
